instruction: You are an AI Sales Agent. Answer customer query about rainy and cloudy day performance.
input: Do solar panels work on cloudy or rainy days?
output: Yes, solar panels continue to generate electricity on cloudy days using diffused daylight, operating at approximately 20% to 40% of their rated peak output. In a hybrid system, any shortfall is automatically balanced by the grid or your battery storage, ensuring your appliances never experience power interruptions.
